name: Tom Suozzi
stance: Co-led a letter to Elon Musk on antisemitic and violent outputs from xAI's Grok and says AI companies racing to ship products must guard against harmful outputs.

statements.text: Co-led with Reps. Gottheimer and Bacon a bipartisan letter to Elon Musk raising concerns over antisemitic and violent messages generated by xAI's Grok chatbot and asking about the internal actions that led to them.
statements.outlet: Capitol Releases (mirror of Office of Rep. Josh Gottheimer)

statements.text: However, their investigation highlights a critical point: AI companies, in their race to create the most innovative and commercially successful product, must be vigilant in combatting biased, slanted, bigoted and antisemitic outputs. It’s a very slippery and dangerous slope.
